review.hypothesis: With80 labels, a lower encoder learning rate may preserve useful pretrained features; inner-only LR and epoch selection can improve adaptation without guessing from Public scores.
review.against: Lower rates may underadapt to retinal imagery; small inner holdouts can choose noisy winners.
controls: Same pretrained encoder/decoder, frozen BN, images384, target, optimizer and augmentation
Reuse original saved inner/final checkpoints for1e-4 control; no control retraining
Compare1e-5 and3e-5 on inner split only, select duration under each objective and refit outer train if selected
Outer labels never used to choose LR or duration
Only first transfer repeat replaced; same fixed branch weights; require at least one genuinely selected new model
risks: Hyperparameter selection on13 inner images is noisy
Original old U-Net OOF biased by checkpoint selection
60-minute hard limit and free GPU only; no guarantee below10
